stem: Brianna realizes that she did not include a position statement in this paper. Which sentence could follow sentence 3 and serve as the position statement for her paper?

options.label: A
options.text: Teenagers must stop lying in the sun, or they will be sure to experience grave consequences.

options.label: B
options.text: Overexposure to tanning beds and natural sunlight has caused huge problems for men and women.

options.label: C
options.text: There are many ways that people can begin to learn more about protecting their skin.

options.label: D
options.text: Skin cancer is on the rise among young people, and teens should make some basic lifestyle changes to help slow this trend.
